title: Hyperglycemic Clamp Procedure in Mice
author: Li Kang
license_note: Confirmed via CrossRef DOI metadata: dx.doi.org/10.17504/protocols.io.yxefxje

steps.title: Perform Surgical Catheterization
steps.instruction: Surgically catheterize the carotid artery and jugular vein in mice at least 5 days prior to the study day.

steps.title: Weigh Mouse and Initiate Fast
steps.instruction: Weigh the mouse and begin fasting (suggested start time between 7:00 and 8:00 AM) by placing the mouse in a plastic container with fresh bedding.

steps.title: Connect Swivel and Collect Basal Samples
steps.instruction: Hook the mouse up to the swivel 4 hours into the fast and collect basal blood/plasma samples 15 and 5 minutes before the start of the clamp.

steps.title: Initiate Hyperglycemic Clamp
steps.instruction: After a total fast of 5 hours, start a variable infusion of 50% glucose to increase and maintain arterial glucose levels at 250-300 mg/dL.

steps.title: Maintain Hematocrit Levels
steps.instruction: Infuse donor blood into the jugular vein catheter throughout the study to prevent a fall in hematocrit.

steps.title: Collect Plasma and C-Peptide Samples
steps.instruction: Measure plasma insulin and C-Peptide concentrations at the specified time points.

substeps.instruction: Collect 25 µl plasma for insulin concentration
Collect 50 µl blood for C-peptide at t = -5, 15, 100, and 120 minutes

steps.title: Harvest Tissues
steps.instruction: At the end of the study, anesthetize the mouse, harvest tissues of interest, and freeze them in liquid nitrogen.
